notes: Modeled, not metered: each town is its population share of its ISO-NE zone (no public town-level data exists).
Zones are approximated by county (Middlesex -> NEMA, Norfolk -> SEMA); e.g. Brookline is counted in SEMA.
All-customer load includes businesses, so commercial centres (downtown Boston) are understated and suburbs overstated.
perCapitaKwh is the same for every town in a zone by construction.
Annual = the zone's observed load over the 365 days to 2026-10-30; residential = EIA residential sales 2025-09 .. 2026-08.
Forecast = the zone's Monte Carlo (2026-11 .. 2027-04); change vs last year = against the same months a year earlier, observed; regime colour = the zone's state on 2026-10-30.
